title: MOiRA workflow step detail
description: Documents the JSON written to workflow_steps.detail by every workflow node. One $def per node variant (success and error paths differ). Known keys are enforced when required; additionalProperties stays true so new keys don't break validation — tighten deliberately, not accidentally.

llm_base.description: Common keys written by every LLM-backed node: the final user prompt, raw model response, and resolved model id. thinking is present only when the model produced thinking content.

tool_result.description: One executed (or synthetically rejected) tool call. The canonical persisted shape uses 'result' (written by active_run's tool_result handler; a truncated preview). The node's internal log uses 'output' instead and appears only in round-error payloads — hence the anyOf. request_id is the echoed evidence-request id — null for model-initiated supplementary calls.

evidence_request.description: Planning's evidence request as stored in structured_output. id is assigned after parsing (req0001...) and may be absent in the raw parsed form.

structured_output.description: Raw parsed decomposition: user_goal, topic, entities, concepts, unknown_facts[{subject, fact_needed}]. Model output — keys checked loosely.

decomposition_error_detail.description: Same base keys as the success shape, but structured_output is absent (the run errored before structured output was produced). Forbidding it keeps a malformed success payload from validating as this variant.

synthesis_error_detail.description: Same base keys as the success shape, but structured_output is absent (the run errored before structured output was produced). Forbidding it keeps a malformed success payload from validating as this variant.

tool_identification_detail.description: Semantic tool discovery output. No LLM prompt/response — this node runs tool-discovery queries per fact.

structured_output.description: Raw parsed planning output; evidence_requests is the field consumed downstream (split/assigned IDs happen after).

planning_error_detail.description: Same base keys as the success shape, but structured_output is absent (the run errored before structured output was produced). Forbidding it keeps a malformed success payload from validating as this variant.

research_detail.description: Full research pass (normal completion). facts_resolved lists facts now unverified (claimed); facts_newly_unknown lists facts still unknown. request_attempt_counts is the compact per-request ledger; the full ledger lives in execution_state. tool_results is appended by active_run's tool_result handler, not by the node itself — absent when the pass issued no calls. new_facts/stalled were added with the 4b progress signal; runs predating it lack them.

research_exit_detail.description: Research short-circuit (budget exhausted or no executor) before any model call: no prompt/response/model, zero rounds, no tool results.

research_round_error_detail.description: Run_error raised mid-pass when a model round returns empty content. tool_results here come from the node's own log and use 'output' rather than the canonical 'result' key.

research_review_error_detail.description: Same base keys as the success shape, but structured_output is absent (the run errored before structured output was produced). Forbidding it keeps a malformed success payload from validating as this variant.

evaluation_error_detail.description: Same base keys as the success shape, but structured_output is absent (the run errored before structured output was produced). Forbidding it keeps a malformed success payload from validating as this variant.

verification_detail.description: Legacy node (retired). Looked like evaluation but also returned new_unknown_facts and carried a tool_results log.

report_generation_legacy_detail.description: Historical minimal shapes from the June spike era, before the detail dict carried prompt/response: either generation_reason (current key) or generation_path (renamed to generation_reason in workflow_runs). Current code always writes the full shape, which matches the primary def first.

report_generation_detail.description: Report generation success. thinking is capped at 2000 chars; raw_response (4000-char cap) appears only on the parse-failure error path.
